question: Is cereal a soup?
scope: A bowl of breakfast cereal with milk. Compare food forms and conventions; a counterexample weakens one criterion without deciding every soup definition.

turns.text: Cereal is soup: there are solid pieces in a liquid, and you eat it with a spoon.

claims.hint: Name another food or drink with pieces in liquid.
Name a spoon food that is not normally soup.

rejected.reason: That is already a soup. Name a different spoon food.

turns.text: Soup must be hot and savory. Cereal is a cold sweet breakfast.

claims.hint: Name a soup normally served cold.

rejected.reason: That is served hot. Name a cold soup.

turns.text: Chilled sweet liquid with chewy pieces is soup-like. That makes a cold sweet bowl enough for soup membership.

claims.text: Chilled sweet liquid with chewy pieces
claims.hint: Name a sweet chilled mixture with another identity.
Name a cold sweet bowl usually called a dessert.

turns.text: Soup is cooked together in one pot. Cereal and milk are prepared separately.

claims.hint: Name a soup made without cooking it together.
Name a soup assembled from separate components.

turns.text: Cereal turns into soup when the flakes soften: soaking and flavor transfer make an integrated liquid dish.

claims.hint: Name a soaked food that is not normally soup.
Name a flavored liquid that is not normally soup.

turns.text: Soup is a savory main course. Sweet milk with soft pieces belongs in the dessert or drink category.

claims.hint: Name a soup served as something sweet.
Name a sweet or milky soup.
